title: A Star Exploded and Was Visible in Daylight for 23 Days

scenes.text: A star exploded in 1054, and people could see it in daylight.
Chinese astronomers spotted it on July fourth, 1054.
The star was about 6,500 light years away.
It stayed bright enough to see in the daytime sky for 23 days.
At night it stayed visible for nearly two years.
Its glowing remains are the Crab Nebula, and you can still see them with a telescope.

description:

first_comment: 23 days in daylight. What would you have thought if you looked up?
